# Brim

> Forecast, history and reminders

Brim: Creatine Tracker — Creatine tracker. iPhone app, available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6795123559?pt=128839649&ct=ai_web

## Guides

- [Creatine Saturation Calculator for iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/brim-app/creatine-saturation-calculator-app): How a creatine saturation estimate works, what Brim's model assumes, and which apps show one.
- [How Long Does Creatine Loading Take?](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/brim-app/how-long-does-creatine-loading-take): Loading versus 3-5 g a day: how long each takes to saturate muscle, and how to track it on iPhone.
- [How to Remember to Take Creatine Every Day](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/brim-app/how-to-remember-to-take-creatine-every-day): Practical ways to stop forgetting creatine, and what happens to your muscle saturation on days you skip.
- [How to Track Creatine Intake on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/brim-app/how-to-track-creatine-intake-on-iphone): Log your daily creatine in one tap on iPhone and see how saturated your muscles are, with an honest comparison of the creatine tracker apps on the App…
